items.title: EVO Player
items.overview: The native player this application is built on: decoding, the audio clock, queues, seeking and the application's life on the console.

items.title: ps5-homebrew-ui
items.overview: The interface kit that draws this page: shapes, text, motion and the standard controls.

items.title: YouTube.js
items.overview: The library the built-in service uses to talk to YouTube. It runs inside the application, behind a loopback address.

items.title: SponsorBlock and DeArrow
items.overview: Community data for skipping segments and for calmer titles and thumbnails. Each can be switched off in the preferences.

items.title: Fonts
items.overview: Inter, Montserrat and DejaVu Sans Mono, each under its own open licence. The full notices ship with the package.

items.title: cJSON
items.overview: A small JSON reader and writer, used wherever the application reads an answer of its service.

items.title: QuickJS
items.overview: The JavaScript engine that runs the built-in service on the console.

items.title: FFmpeg
items.overview: Demuxing and software decoding for the formats the hardware decoders do not take.

items.title: Everyone who tested
items.overview: Thank you for the reports, the logs and the patience. Feedback is one row away, under About.
